results.title: Six Ways to Decrease Reader Variability in Clinical Trials | Banook
results.content: # **Six Ways to Decrease Reader Variability in Clinical Trials**. The reproducibility and accuracy of imaging-based tumor measurements are* *important* *as clinical decisions and drug efficacy determinations are often based on the assumption that a change in imaging measurements reflects a true change in tumor size.*. The interpretation of a medical image is known as the read, and the expert performing the read is known as the reader (or observer). Reading an image is inherently subjective, and as such there is variability in the reads. * **Intra-reader variability:** measurement differences from the same reader, which usually stem from the difficulty of the imaging case or reader interpretation drift (i.e., deviation from study-specific image interpretation criteria on which readers have been trained). Reader variability can in turn increase the variability of clinical trial data and lead to misinterpretations of cancer drug efficacy. Differential ways of acquiring the image, the level of reader training and the information that is available to the reader all contribute to reader variability.

results.title: Automatic adjudication based on the inter-annotator agreement | by 🍃tagtog | Medium
results.content: # Automatic adjudication based on the inter-annotator agreement. When annotators label the same data, adjudication is the process to resolve inconsistencies among the different versions and to promote a final version to the gold standard (*master*). In a multi-user annotation environment, adjudication is usually a manual and lengthy process. If you want to know more about the different types of methods for adjudication you can read this post: The adjudication process in collaborative annotation. ### Overlapping in the annotated data. There must be overlapping within the data annotated. For instance, three different users must annotate each document. Before starting the production work, it is usually required to go over several annotation sessions to refine the guidelines. We calculate the IAA automatically while users annotate. **It chooses the annotations from the available-best annotator for each annotation task.**. It follows a merging strategy based on choosing the annotations from the user with the highest IAA for all the documents for a specific annotation task. Let's create a new project and edit the settings. In certain cases, the annotation tasks created might cause confusion across your team. In this example **3 different annotators will annotate each document**. As tagtog supports **Markdown**, I have imported formatted text, so the content is more engaging for the annotation process. Once all users annotated and confirmed their version of the documents assigned, we have enough information to calculate the **agreement among annotators (IAA)**. For example: *member03* and *jorge* agree on the 84.41% of the cases for the annotation task *techicalSkill*. Whereas, *member03* and *jorge* agree on the 74.27% of the cases for the annotation task *softSkill*. * ***jorge*** is the annotator with the highest IAA average for the annotation task *technicalSkill*. * ***member03*** is the annotator with the highest IAA average for the annotation task *softSkill*. It **integrates the best annotations for each annotation task**. These resulting annotations go to the master version. tagtog integrated the *technicalSkill* annotations from *jorge* (top annotator for the annotation task) and the *softSkill* annotations from *member03* (top annotator for the annotation task). results.title: Endpoint Adjudication: Definitions and Tools
results.content:
Title: Endpoint Adjudication: Definitions and Tools
# Endpoint Adjudication Definitions, Procedures and Tools. ### Endpoint Adjudication. The procedure by which clinical events identified as potential endpoints are submitted to a panel of independent experts to be assessed in a blinded way. * The procedures to handle disagreements in Central Adjudication Committee (CEC) members assessments. Same as Clinical Endpoint Adjudication. A meeting, usually face to face, between (selected) Adjudication Committee members, to resolve the events with conflicting CEC Members' judgments following initial assessment. ### EAC: Endpoints Adjudication Committee. ### Event Adjudication. The procedures to make the Event Dossier ready for the submission to the Adjudication Committee. The process by which the Adjudication Coordinator is submitting a potential endpoint that's has been already assessed by the Committee, for a new assessment by the Committee due to a relevant change or update in the Patient's Medical records. The information systems, legacy software, documents or clinical procedures from which the potential endpoint event information originates. The process by which all the personal or site information are removed from the Event's Medical records before assembling the Event's Dossier and submitting it to the Adjudication Committee. The current status of potential endpoint events during the Adjudication workflow. The process by which the Adjudication Coordinator presents a potential endpoint, together with its information package, to the Reviewers for the assessment. Attributes that identify such a potential endpoint and the criteria that allow its detection are usually defined in the Adjudication Charter. The potential endpoints qualification as “real” Study Endpoints is made by the Committee Members and constitutes the core of the Clinical Adjudication process. The procedures ensuring that every Reviewer included in the Adjudication Committee, is well qualified (with appropriate training) for the Clinical Assessments requested by the Adjudication Charter. A quality control metric of the Endpoint Adjudication procedure aimed at detecting and measuring the grade of consistency of a Reviewer's assessments over time. A quality control metric of the Endpoint Adjudication procedure aimed at detecting and measuring the level of disagreement among the Reviewers. A set of procedures, measurements and metrics used to control and maintain the quality of the Endpoint Adjudication. Download Ethical eAdjudication for Endpoint Adjudication Dossier.
